items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All five requested lifecycle parts and the cross-cutting ACs are implemented; the final Stage-2 review is empty and no out-of-scope compatibility mode was added.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: CLI, helper, store, tolerant-reader, timezone, and malformed-calendar boundaries refuse invalid inputs or resolve damaged stored values conservatively.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Stored fields remain untrusted: JSON uses structured serialization and both human renderers escape hostile values or emit a fixed unreadable-date placeholder; no credentials were added.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Behavior-level happy, refusal, expiry, race, producer, schema, rendering, cap, and contract paths are covered; the latest targeted runs passed 165/165 lifecycle tests and 122/122 schema/store/lifecycle tests.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Human deferred sections share a deterministic cap, machine JSON remains deliberately complete, and the store keeps its existing linear union/read behavior without new I/O loops.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Lifecycle, contract, and Markdown concerns are separated into focused shared modules; every intentional existing-file ceiling raise is measured and covered by ADR-121, and the file-size gate passes.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer→append-only JSONL→resolved view→CLI/Markdown round trips and tracked∪outbox composition are covered; contractVersion 2 names the WebUI consumer card trg-f2214310, and schema validation now enforces real calendar dates.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: `scan_test_hygiene.py --diff` completed with no findings after the final test changes.
